policies: Preserve the original tensor objects and original row membership.

claims.interpretation_guard: Nonzero cyclicity is a premise for successful reconstruction, not a premise for recognising chart failure. Requiring it for this refusal claim would exclude precisely the zero and singular rows being covered.
claims.assessment: T2 sections 2 and 3 restrict successful reconstruction to the nonzero cyclic and numerically conditioned domain. T2 section 12 separately lists zero, contraction-null, repeated-spectrum, noncyclic and condition-refusal rows. T4 section 6 supplies symmetric fallback or pool-level abstention. The proposed boundary covers refusal without assuming successful cyclicity.
claims.remaining_boundary: No all-strata reconstruction, manufactured axes, zero imputation or reference-only deletion. No concrete null pool or decoder execution admitted.
claims.remaining_empirical_admission: No concrete null pool or decoder run is admitted by this annotation.
